summary: Sprint 30 (ARL Indicators dashboard + AI Document Generator with 32 MinTrabajo templates) tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed. Frontend: Indicadores ARL page loads with hero + 3 sections + selectors + PDF/Excel buttons; AI Document dialog opens with 32 templates and generates a real Markdown document (10K chars, Spanish, company auto-injected) within ~30s, persists as draft, edit toggle works.

issues: When cumplimiento=0% the hero is solid red which is correct semantically, but 'NIT N/A' is shown because the default 'Mi Empresa' lacks NIT in DB. Consider either (a) seeding a NIT for the default company or (b) hiding the NIT chip when missing. Cosmetic only.

GPT-5.2 renders missing fields as **[POR DEFINIR]** because the active company has NIT/Ciudad/economic_activity empty. Auto-injection itself is working (Razon social 'Mi Empresa' and the customization 'Bogota' are correctly used). To make demos look complete, populate /api/companies seed with NIT, ciudad, actividad_economica.

action_items: (Optional) Seed default 'Mi Empresa' with NIT, ciudad, economic_activity, sedes so AI-generated documents and ARL hero render fully populated in demos.

(Optional) Add timezone-aware end-of-month calculation in get_arl_indicators (current logic uses '{year}-{month+1:02d}-01' which works for $lte string compare on YYYY-MM-DD but treats day=1 of next month as inclusive, slightly over-counting boundary records). Low impact in practice.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4480 lines (was 4133) - splitting into modules (indicators/, documents_ai/, etc.) is increasingly important.

export_arl_indicators_excel and export_arl_indicators_pdf call get_arl_indicators(year, month, user) directly bypassing FastAPI dependency resolution - works because user is already resolved by their own Depends, but it's tightly coupled. Consider extracting a pure function _compute_arl(cid, year, month) and have all 3 endpoints call it.
generate_document_with_ai has no max length / token guard on customizations field - a very long customizations payload could blow up the system prompt. Suggest clamping to ~2KB.

The company_block in generate_document_with_ai uses get('city') but the document_templates prompt asks for ciudad. The company schema field is 'city' here - confirm schema (some places use 'ciudad'). If mixed, the AI sees N/A for ciudad. Verify Company model field name.

PUT /api/documents/{id}/ai-content does not enforce that the document belongs to the caller's company_id - admin/sgsst could overwrite ai_generated_content of a doc in another company if they know the id. Add company_id check (same applies to GET /ai-content).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (ARL page renders + AI dialog generates 10K-char Markdown doc and persists)
